_description: MCP server for local filesystem operations. Useful when Copilot CLI needs to work with files outside the current workspace or perform batch file operations.
tools_provided: read_file - Read contents of a file
read_multiple_files - Read multiple files at once
write_file - Create or overwrite a file
edit_file - Make targeted edits to a file
move_file - Move or rename a file
search_files - Search for files by name pattern
get_file_info - Get file metadata (size, modified date)
list_allowed_directories - Show which directories the server can access
configuration_notes: Replace ${workspaceFolder} with the actual directory path you want to expose
You can pass multiple directory paths as additional args to allow access to several locations
The server restricts access to only the specified directories for security
Copilot CLI already has built-in file tools (view, edit, create, grep, glob) — use this MCP server only if you need additional filesystem capabilities
